# Observe & perf

Traces of every turn and tool call, an activity log, a browser preview of dev servers, and hot reload that waits for idle.

Pack id `observe`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/traces`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/traces/README.md) — Local OTLP/HTTP trace receiver and viewer: trace list, span waterfall, operation stats and error groups inside DSH.
2. [`@dshfiles/activity-timeline`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/activity-timeline/README.md) — Unified chronological activity timeline across agents, sessions, communication, and jj workspaces.
3. [`@dshfiles/preview`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/preview/README.md) — Agent browser tools over a Host-managed headless Chromium scoped per thread, and the dev servers each thread started.
4. [`@dshfiles/hmr-gate`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/hmr-gate/README.md) — Web client HMR transport that only announces a rebuilt plugin while its Host half is the code the running Host loaded.

## Prerequisites

None.

## Key settings

1. **Where traces are stored**: Settings entry `dshfiles-traces`, field `mode`.
2. **Hosts the preview browser may open**: Settings entry `dshfiles-preview`, field `allowedHosts`.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Observe & perf under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `observe`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs observe` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
